audit: independent empirical lateral response from existing C/D and collision geometry

coordinate_convention.normalization: C displacement projected onto initial body +Y axis [-sin(initial_yaw),cos(initial_yaw),0]; sign-adjusted for each command. This is mapped to official goal lateral sign by negating command sign.

reachable_lower_envelope.interpretation: Empirical lower envelope under the measured sustained command protocols; use 0 reachable movement credit for elapsed<=1 s, and keep the separate 0.02 m adverse excursion reserve.

geometry.formula: Each geom: sum(norm(body_pos)) from free trunk to geom body + norm(geom_pos) + geom_rbound. Triangle inequality holds under arbitrary joint and trunk rotations; use maximum over 20 audited eligible K1 collision geoms.
geometry.claim: The whole official collision model stays inside the post inner-face lateral corridor at any articulation if root center plus empirical motion reserves stays within the stated bound. This is more restrictive than checking post distance only at the 0.6 m forward offset.
geometry.provisional_0_95_bound_status: Not certified: would require independently verified moving body lateral support <=0.41 m after clearance/stop/reversal allowances.

methodology: Read original NPZ positions and JSON phase timing; no rerun, policy edits, scene edits or modifications to stages C/D/E.
Use nearest physics-step indices at protocol boundaries and finite differences of base positions for independent displacement/speed measurement.

Minimum sustained speed is the minimum of all 0.5 s forward sliding displacement windows wholly inside source steady window (discard min(2 s, half phase duration)); also retain 1 s minimum and instantaneous body lateral minimum.
Averages of reported body velocity are supplementary; planned speed comes from actual displacement, not the 0.2 command.

Stop distance is maximum forward excursion across the entire 5 s zero-command phase, not net displacement. Original sustained stop test requires five consecutive 0.2 s mean velocity bins under [0.05,0.05,0.1]; its timestamp is onset, not completion of the confirming 1 s.

Compile unmodified D scene; cross-check geometry eligibility/post dimensions against independent E collision audit. Use model geom_rbound instead of treating compiled mesh size as an exact oriented box.

Recommended parameters round conservatively: minimum 0.5 s speed 0.106815 down to 0.10; adverse reversal <=0.010923 up to 0.02; stop <=0.059930 up to 0.07; low-speed onset<=0.8 up to1.0; confirmation<=1.8 up to2.0.
scope_limits: Deterministic simulation replay, not a statistical or hardware guarantee.
Movement tests hold lateral command for 3-6 s after 2 s settling, or 4 s switches. Lower envelope is checked only on measured trajectories, not arbitrary short recurrent pulses.
Pure stopping evidence covers 5 s zero command; slow residual drift exists. Reversal to yaw command is excluded from pure stopping statistics.
C covers 1/2 ms; D full field uses 1 ms/20 ms policy. Runtime must use official body-frame commands and scene frame transforms.
C/D NPZ omit full joint positions. Initialized pose width cannot certify a gait-specific moving width; all-articulation collision bounds avoid that unsupported assumption.
No collision blocker width, impact success or catching guarantee is inferred from base velocity or goal-center reachability.
